visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Table Not in Descending Order
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 6 should print VI, but the program prints IVII.

solution.explanation: The greedy method only works when the table runs from the biggest value to the smallest. With 4 listed before 5, the number 6 matches 4 first (IV) and the rest becomes II, instead of using V first.
